class.name: omni_plan_dispatcher/SequentialPlanDispatcher
class.description: Sequential plan dispatcher: executes PDDL plan actions one at a time in topological order. Simplest dispatcher, useful for debugging or environments where parallel execution causes resource contention.

class.name: omni_plan_dispatcher/ParallelPlanDispatcher
class.description: Parallel plan dispatcher: executes PDDL plan actions concurrently using a bounded thread pool. Actions are dispatched as soon as all their causal dependencies have succeeded, maximising parallelism.
